description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing web configuration related to telephony voice services, including SIP and line configurations, with conditional support for different versions.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_TelcoVoipParams
methods.description: Processes web configuration data for telephony VOIP parameters from a msgpack object into a TelcoVoice_WebConfig_t structure.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_VoiceServiceParams
methods.description: Processes voice service parameters from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_VoiceServiceTable_t structure.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_LineTable
methods.description: Processes line table data from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_LineTable_t structure.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_SipNetworkTable
methods.description: Processes SIP network table data from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_SipNwTable_t structure (conditional on feature).

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_SipClientTable
methods.description: Processes SIP client table data from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_SipClientTable_t structure (conditional on feature).

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_ProfileTable
methods.description: Processes profile table data from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_VoIPTable_t structure (conditional on feature).

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_POTSFxsTable
methods.description: Processes POTSFxs table data from a msgpack object map into a WebConfig_POTSFxsTable_t structure (conditional on feature).
